prompt: deepseek是什么时候火遍全球的，deepseek做了什么？
scope: Local reproduction with synthetic group context. Original QQ incident logs were unavailable; this reproduces the same fixed fallback but does not prove the original conversation had an identical trace.
conclusion: The reproduced failure is premature termination before page reading, not exhaustion of the tool-round limit. Increasing the limit alone from 2 to 4 cannot change an early return after a model answer.

baseline.outcomeWithLimit4AndIdenticalPrefix: 这个我没查到可靠的消息，暂时不确定。

causeChain: Native Messages API returned real web_search_result entries but no cited_text citations. The pinned official mapping correctly retained only source URLs/titles; it discards generated provider prose.
The original search formatter invited URL citations even for URL-only discovery. The model answered without invoking web_fetch.
The bot correctly rejected an answer with no usable evidence, but immediately returned its fixed uncertainty message without a corrective turn despite having unused tool budget.
changes: Adapter marks URL-only search output as discovery_only and asks the model to read a source before claiming verification; vendored upstream code remains unchanged.

Count actual tool-calling rounds. If a URL-only search is followed by a premature answer, allow at most one corrective model turn within the remaining tool budget, with tool_choice=auto. Unverified draft is not added to context or sent to QQ.
Log tool outcome, evidence status, errors, HTTP status, budget use and correction use, without query text or API keys.

validations.mode: Replay initial model search and identical old URL-only results; remaining model/fetch requests live
Also replay old premature answer; remaining corrective model/fetch requests live

tokens.definition: All input and output tokens, including cache-read input. Counts are not monetary prices. Replayed prefixes are not billed again.

entirelyFreshFixedRun.comparisonCaveat: Used three search queries instead of two; not a matched cost comparison.

limits: These are targeted reproductions, not an independent statistical reliability or naturalness benchmark.
Success means actual readable page evidence and a sourced answer about the requested timeline. No claim that every wording or secondary-source assertion is factually perfect.
Actual page failures, unreadable content, absent credentials or exhausted budget can still produce uncertainty; refusing to fabricate remains intentional.
No QQ connection or production bot restart occurred. Local .env was not changed. Source changes have not been pushed.
